caption:
🚇 One day on the Paris Metro — Thursday 22 October 2026.

11,620 trains across all 16 lines, from the first departure before dawn to the last one after midnight. Each dot is a scheduled train moving along the real track, in its line colour. Rush hour peaks at 503 trains on the move at 08:10 — and line 14 now runs all the way to Orly airport.

📊 Data: Île-de-France Mobilités GTFS timetable (transport.data.gouv.fr).
